identification: Full-size Kookaburra cricket bat with printed Cascade Tasmanian Tigers 2000/2001 squad panel, signed in pen by 21 squad members. Photos show Ricky Ponting's name panel with a signature beside it, plus Cox, Hills, Di Venuto, Young, Marsh, Clingeleffer, Colegrave, Downton, Mason, Targett, Wright, Atkinson, Geeves, Daly, Saker. Signatures somewhat faded, bat clean. No provenance or COA seen.

viewing_check: Check the Ponting signature closely: photograph it up close, compare with known Ponting autographs from 2000-01 and look for ink on the printed panel only versus a pen on the wood; check how many names are actually signed (about 21 listed, a few look faint or missing, eg Denton, Dykes, Pinnington); look for any COA, club or collector label, and bat condition (cracks, grip).
